scope: Native authenticated release discovery, download, immutable staging and bounded executable version verification; no installed-service update activation
clippy: workspace all-targets with warnings denied: passed
checks: Catalog URLs cannot introduce an unconfigured credential authority; requests use saved control authorities and URL-encoded path segments
Catalog checks machine identity, platform, target, asset, version, bounded size, digest and duplicate targets
Streaming downloads verify response identity, length and SHA256 before immutable publication; interrupted network responses may use configured fallbacks
Redirects never forward credentials; authentication rejection stops fallback
Cancellation, bad headers, oversized/truncated/corrupt bodies and unsafe directories do not publish a release or leave temporary files
ARMv7 versus ARM baseline selection uses the compilation target
Actual API-published current agent executable is downloaded, staged and verified with bounded version-command output and lifetime
Wrong executable version and post-staging tampering fail verification; tampering does not publish a second hash directory
limitations: The new update module is preparation for the activation worker; it is not automatic service updating or a new CLI update command
Durable activation/rollback, shared CLI publication and post-readiness update acknowledgement remain unfinished
This verification does not execute non-Linux platform releases or rebuild production images
No production deployment, installed client upgrade, commit/push or physical bandwidth test was performed
